description: The shared Renovate preset every a11ign repository extends (local>a11ign/.github; a11ign/a11ign#5221, #5153). OFF until a repository's own renovate.json sets enabled: true. Titles read `deps: bump <package> from <x> to <y>`, the handle the gate recognises a dependency pull request by. No dashboard or config-error issues (the token holds issues: read only). One pull request open at a time; automerge hands the pull request to GitHub's own auto-merge, so the approving review and the merge queue `main` requires still decide. A major bump, and any 0.x bump (below 1.0 a minor is the breaking one), is never automerged.
prFooter: Opened by the shared Renovate preset in a11ign/.github (a11ign/a11ign#5153). To stop these, set `"enabled": false` in this repository's renovate.json.

packageRules.description: A major bump is a person's decision
Below 1.0 a minor bump is the breaking one
